overview.description: The ProShares Ultra NVDA (NVDB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure to the daily returns of NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) stock, less expenses. NVDB was launched on Sep 8, 2025 and is issued by ProShares.
